/-- At the header (block 1): `c` (value 1) counts the positives seen so far, `i` (value 2)

def cpInv (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 15 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ c i : BitVec 64, env[1]? = some (.int 64 c) ∧ env[2]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧
    -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt + 1 ≤ max len.toInt 0 ∧ 0 ≤ c.toInt ∧ c.toInt ≤ i.toInt + 1

abbrev cpPost (xs : List (BitVec 64)) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun ret _ => ∃ n : BitVec 64, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ xs.length

theorem cp_step (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (href : ref ≠ 0)

  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, hA, h3, hh, c, i, h1, h2, hi1, hi2, hc0, hc1⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hA
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h2
  have hi1' : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f1 rfl
  wp_simp [f1]
  simp [e0, e2, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : (i + 1#64).slt len
  · -- exit: return c
    simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f1 [f1] as n
    simp [e1, hsz, cpPost]
    omega
  · -- body
    simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    dsimp only
    have hcc : (c + 1#64).toInt = c.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have hiu : (i + 1#64).ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) hc
    have hin : ((i + 1#64).toNat : Int) = (i + 1#64).toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (by omega)
    have hix : (i + 1#64).toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hk : (i + 1#64).toNat = (i.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616 := by
      simp [BitVec.toNat_add]
    have hix2 : (i.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616 < xs.length := by rw [← hk]; exact hix
    have hload := heapLoad_arr (k := (i.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616) href hh (by simpa using hix2)
    wp_step prog_f1 [f1] as n

    · -- positive: block 4 adds 1
      try dsimp only
      wp_step prog_f1 [f1] as n
      simp [hsz, e1]
      apply wpPtN_le (show n ≤ n + 1 + 1 by omega) (ih _ _ _)
      refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simpa [hsz] using e0, by simpa [hsz] using e3, hh, c + 1#64, i + 1#64,
        by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

def indInv (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (xs_len : BitVec 64) (xs_ref : Nat) (x : BitVec 64)
    (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 12 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice xs_ref 0 xs_len xs_len) ∧
  env[1]? = some (.int 64 x) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 xs_len) ∧
  s.heap[xs_ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ i : BitVec 64, env[2]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt < xs_len.toInt ∧
    ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < xs.length), (j : Int) ≤ i.toInt → xs[j] ≠ x

def indPost (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (x : BitVec 64) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun ret _ => ∃ r : BitVec 64, ret = .int 64 r ∧
    (r.toInt = -1 ∨ ∃ (i : Nat) (h : i < xs.length), r.toInt = i ∧ xs[i] = x)

theorem bvm1 : (18446744073709551615#64).toInt = -1 := by
  first | decide | rfl | simp

theorem post_none (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (x : BitVec 64) (st : HState Val) :
    indPost xs x (.int 64 (18446744073709551615#64)) st := by
  unfold indPost
  exact ⟨18446744073709551615#64, rfl, Or.inl bvm1⟩

theorem post_found (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (x : BitVec 64) (r : BitVec 64) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hr : r.toInt = (k : Int)) (hx : xs[k] = x) (st : HState Val) :
    indPost xs x (.int 64 r) st := by
  unfold indPost
  exact ⟨r, rfl, Or.inr ⟨k, hk, hr, hx⟩⟩

theorem ind_step (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (xs_len : BitVec 64) (xs_ref : Nat) (x : BitVec 64)
    (hlen : xs_len.toInt = xs.length) (hL : xs_len.toInt < 2 ^ 63) (hr : xs_ref ≠ 0) :
    ∀ n env s, indInv xs xs_len xs_ref x env s →
      (∀ env' s', indInv xs xs_len xs_ref x env' s' →
        wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨3, 1⟩ (indPost xs x) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 (n + 1) ⟨3, 1⟩ (indPost xs x) env s := by
  intro n env s hI ih
  have pf : prog.funcs[3]? = some f3 := rfl
  unfold indInv at hI
  obtain ⟨hsz, hv0, hv1, hv3, hh, i, hv2, hlo, hhi, hall⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv1
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv2
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv3
  apply wpPtN_of_block pf rfl
  wp_simp [f3]
  simp [e0, e2, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : (i + 1#64).slt xs_len
  · -- exit: block 3 returns -1
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f3] as n
    first
      | (simp [hsz, post_none]; done)
      | (simp [hsz]; exact post_none xs x _)
      | exact post_none xs x _
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    have hi1' : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have hin : ((i + 1#64).toNat : Int) = (i + 1#64).toInt :=
      toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (by omega)
    have hix : (i + 1#64).toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hiu : (i + 1#64).ult xs_len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) (by omega)
    have hload := heapLoad_arr (r := xs_ref) (k := (i + 1#64).toNat) hr hh (by simpa using hix)
    have hk : (i + 1#64).toNat = (i.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616 := by
      first
        | simp [BitVec.toNat_add]
        | (rw [BitVec.toNat_add]; rfl)
    have hloadm := hload
    simp only [hk] at hloadm
    by_cases hx : xs[(i + 1#64).toNat] = x
    · have hxm := hx
      simp only [hk] at hxm
      wp_step pf [f3] as n
      simp [e0, e1, hsz, dp_indexAddr hiu, hloadm, hxm]
      wp_step pf [f3] as n
      try simp [hsz]
      first
        | exact post_found xs x _ (i + 1#64).toNat hix (by omega) hx _
        | (simp [indPost]; omega)
    · have hxm := hx
      simp only [hk] at hxm
      wp_step pf [f3] as n
      simp [e0, e1, hsz, dp_indexAddr hiu, hloadm, hxm]
      refine wpPtN_le (show n ≤ n + 1 by omega) (ih _ _ ?_)
      unfold indInv
      refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz, e0, hv0], by simp [hsz, e1, hv1],
        by simp [hsz, e3, hv3], hh, i + 1#64, by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj hji
      by_cases hj' : (j : Int) ≤ i.toInt
      · exact hall j hj hj'
      · have hjk : j = (i + 1#64).toNat := by omega
        subst hjk
        exact hx

have hL : xs_len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by
    have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 xs_len
    simpa using this
  refine wpFun_mono (Q := indPost xs x) (fun v s' h => h) ?_
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f3
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f3 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f3]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f3 (indInv xs xs_len xs_ref x)
    (ind_step xs xs_len xs_ref x h_xs_len hL h_xs_ref)
  unfold indInv
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, h_xs, 18446744073709551615#64, by simp,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [bvm1]; omega
  · rw [bvm1]; omega
  · intro j hj hj1
    rw [bvm1] at hj1
    exfalso

/-- Invariant at the loop header (block 1): `i` (value 1) is the last index
visited (starting at -1), `len` (value 2) and the slice (value 0) are
unchanged, and every element up to index `i` is nonnegative. -/
def allInv (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (xs_ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64)
    (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 13 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice xs_ref 0 len len) ∧ env[2]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  s.heap[xs_ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧

    ∀ j (hj : j < xs.length), (j : Int) ≤ i.toInt → 0 ≤ xs[j].toInt

  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f0
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f0]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f0 (allInv xs xs_ref xs_len)
  · intro m env1 s1 hI ih
    obtain ⟨hsz, hv0, hv2, hh, i, hv1, hlo, hhi, hall⟩ := hI
    obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv0
    obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv1
    obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv2
    apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f0 rfl
    wp_simp [f0]
    simp [e0, e1, e2, hsz]
    generalize hj : i + 1#64 = j
    have hj1 : j.toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [← hj, BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have hjn0 : 0 ≤ j.toInt := by omega
    have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hjn0
    cases hc : j.slt xs_len
    · -- exit: every index has been visited
      simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
      try dsimp only
      have hfin : ∀ y ∈ xs, 0 ≤ y.toInt := by
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hy
        exact hall t ht (by omega)

      first
        | exact fun _ => hfin

        | (intro _ y hy; simpa using hfin y hy)
        | (intro y hy; simpa using hfin y hy)

      by_cases hx : 0 ≤ (xs[j.toNat]).toInt
      · have hs : (xs[j.toNat]).slt 0#64 = false := by
          simp only [BitVec.slt, hz, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt]; omega
        wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as q

        apply ih
        unfold allInv
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hh, j, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz, e1, e2]; done)
        · first

            | (simp [hsz]; exact e0)
            | (simp [hsz]; exact hv0)

            | (simp [hsz, e2]; done)

        · omega
        · omega
        · intro t ht hle

abbrev fillPost (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (r : Nat) (v : BitVec 64) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun _ s' => ∃ ys : List (BitVec 64), s'.heap[r]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
